title: Thin clients: Python and TypeScript
description:
**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Apps need only `PutEvents` with the schema. Add the smallest helper per language: `caducus.notify.client` first (Papyrus), a small npm package when Chatticus adopts. No shared UI package until a second app needs it.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started.

**Depends on:** kanbus-ff4727

comments.author: home
comments.text: No longer applies: the package is the client, and there is no event bus or API to call.
